name: How do I choose between repairing my deck and replacing it entirely?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between repairing my deck and replacing it entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repairing and replacing a deck depends on the extent of damage and the deck's overall structural integrity. If only a few boards or railings are damaged, repair is often sufficient. However, if more than 25% of the deck's structure, including support posts and joists, shows significant rot, extensive termite damage, or irreparable structural failure, a full replacement is usually more cost-effective and safer in the long run. Hometelligent Inc. can assess your deck's condition and provide a detailed recommendation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose repair for minor damage; consider replacement if over 25% of the structure is compromised or if there's extensive rot or termite damage.
